title: HELIX Bridge: Workday Student → Hold
architecture_notes: Workday Student uses Student Holds (Action Items / Service Indicators) to block or flag students — registration holds, financial holds, advising holds, transcript holds. Equivalent to PS_SRVC_IND_DATA (service indicators).

source_objects.description: A hold placed on a student: type, reason, placed date, released date, impact. Equivalent to PS_SRVC_IND_DATA.
The hold classification and what it blocks. Equivalent to PS_SRVC_IND_CD_TBL.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map to HELIX hold-type terminology (registration, financial, advising, transcript, disciplinary, health, library, ferpa).
Direct map. Why the hold was placed.
For financial holds, the balance triggering it. GLBA-relevant if aid-related.
Null if active. Cast to ISO 8601 if released.
Boolean. Whether this hold blocks enrollment.
Boolean. Whether this hold blocks transcript release.
Map to HELIX AcademicOrg (office that placed the hold).
